messages:
elaine: Kicking off a short coordination thread for post-assessment verification. Key buckets: RBAC rollback window, KMS evidence-key rotation, audit export integrity, vuln quick-sweep, and retest handoff. I sketched a minimal playbook and owners below.

tom: thanks. can you paste the rbacs snapshot command you used in the runbook? want to diff against the last good snapshot.

elaine: sure: `rbac-snapshot --cluster prod --output /tmp/rbac-2026-03-18.json` then `rbac-diff /snapshots/rbac-2026-03-01.json /tmp/rbac-2026-03-18.json --filter=roleBinding,clusterRoleBinding`. also `aws iam list-role-policies --role-name <role>` for suspect roles.

devin: for KMS: propose rotating the evidence-ingest CMK alias immediately, but keep app CMKs unchanged until smoke tests pass. We'll publish the new public key to the assessor bucket.

frank: Agree. Also add a step to snapshot key policies before rotation: `aws kms get-key-policy --key-id <id> --policy-name default > pre-rotate-policy.json`. We should keep that in the JIRA ticket.

ops-bot: Reminder: Audit export scheduled at 2026-03-18T20:00Z. Destination s3://redwood-audit/exports/1773459001.tar.gz

elaine: Audit checklist (short): 1) verify sequence continuity for last 48h 2) sample immutability headers on exported objects 3) cross-check KMS encryption context entries for evidence-ingest 4) confirm no gaps in SSO event stream.

devin: vuln quick-sweep plan: run `quickscan --targets=prod-api,ingest --severity=medium,high` then triage results; config fixes can be patched same day, code fixes go to a 48h sprint.

tom: RBAC rollback playbook stub: - take live snapshot - apply rollback via `rbac-apply --from-snapshot <snapshot>` - run smoke auth tests - if failures, revert using snapshot-restore. I'll author full steps and include CLI outputs.

frank: For assessor handoff: create timeboxed public key object + verification instructions. Example verification command: `openssl dgst -sha256 -verify pub.pem -signature evidence.sig payload.json` and a short script to replay events `tools/replay_events.sh --bundle bundle.tar.gz --start 2026-03-15T00:00Z`.

elaine: timeline: today EOD - RBAC diff + rollback PR (owner: tom). Tomorrow morning - KMS rotate for evidence keys and canary ingest (owner: devin). Tomorrow noon - audit export sampling (owner: frank). Afternoon - vuln sweep + triage (owner: elaine). Retest slot: tentatively 2026-03-20 13:00-15:00 UTC.

ops-bot: Note: extra retention enabled on audit bucket for 72 hours at devin's request. TTL updated.

devin: I'll publish the README for key rotation and add the HMAC verification step for bundles. Also will upload new alias metadata to the ticket.

tom: PR opened: github.com/redwood/sec/compare/rbac-rollbacks-1773459001 -> please review. Links in JIRA SEC-4367.

frank: Doing audit sampling now, will post sample hashes and sequence continuity check in the ticket.

elaine: one risk callout: if we rotate evidence keys before assessor has fetched verification key, we need a clear onboarding link and TTL. Add that to the README.

devin: will add TTL 48h and pre-signed get objects + KMS-encrypted metadata for the assessor.

frank: Samples show continuity ok, no gaps in SSO events. Posting hashes: sha256 sums attached in ticket.

elaine: great. I'll consolidate docs into SEC-4367 and move to 'verification in progress'. ping here if anything blocks the retest window. :white_check_mark:

tom: confirmed availability for retest window.

devin: confirmed. will monitor ingest canary during window.

frank: available for audit replay and validation.

elaine: closing thread for now, will re-open with final links and evidence bundle after rotation and scans complete.
